name: bakesbymom-design-system
description: Bakes by Mom: design tokens, React component library, Storybook and the website.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bakesbymom/tokens && npm run build -w @bakesbymom/ui
scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm run build -w @bakesbymom/web
scripts.web: npm run build && npm run dev -w @bakesbymom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bakesbymom/ui && npm run typecheck -w @bakesbymom/web && tsc -p .storybook/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bakesbymom/tokens && npm run test -w @bakesbymom/ui && npm run test -w @bakesbymom/web
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build:tokens && storybook build -o storybook-static
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run build -w @bakesbymom/web && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build-storybook
